title: Last life values
description: The file game/tuning/last_life.json: the last-life delay and the stand-in burst the ship bursts into on the last life, read in both run modes. DRA-125. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from core.last_life (the DEFAULT_* constants). {} is a valid file. last_life_delay is the GDD's key (02-game-flow.md, Values). The burst values are the stand-in the Director approved (scope report DRA-125, Values needed, Burst), not in the GDD, until LD-08 sets the life-lost feedback (10-ui.md, life_lost_feedback). The burst's color is not here: like every placeholder color it is a view constant. Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app/tuning-loader.md) into core.last_life.LastLifeRules. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/run.md, Rules (The last life, A last-life tick, Burst).

last_life_delay.description: Ticks from the ship bursting on the last life to the game-over screen. The world runs on and the burst fades over exactly these ticks. Default: 02-game-flow.md, last_life_delay (guess). Maps to LastLifeRules.delay_ticks.

burst_particle_count.description: Squares in the burst, flying out in that many evenly spread directions. Default: scope report DRA-125, Values needed, Burst (stand-in). Maps to LastLifeRules.burst_particle_count.

burst_particle_speed.description: Px each square moves per tick, away from the burst's origin. An int or a float, never a bool. Default: scope report DRA-125, Values needed, Burst (stand-in). Maps to LastLifeRules.burst_particle_speed.

burst_particle_size.description: Side of each square, px. Default: scope report DRA-125, Values needed, Burst (stand-in). Maps to LastLifeRules.burst_particle_size.
